title: MT41020: Nano-Structured Materials
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite - NilIntroduction: Historical perspective, scope, structural
novelty and architecture synthesis and processing of nanostured materials:
Synthesis from vapor, liquid and solid states - chemical synthesis and
processing of particles, films, coatings, and self-assembled structures.
Mechano-chemical synthesis methods and severe plastic deformation. Thermal
spray processing of nanocrystalline materials, Nanocrystalline powder
consolidation methods and bulk nanomaterials, Electrodeposited/co-deposited
nanocrystalline materials, Carbon nanotubes, Bulk metallic glasses.Properties
and applications of nanostructured materials: Diffusion, Reactions with gas and
liquid, Catalysis and electrocatalysis, Gas storage and sensing, Mechanical
behavior of nanocrystalline metals and nanocomposites. Magnetic properties
ÃÂ¢ÃÂÃÂ GMR, TMR. Electronic, optical and photoelectric properties, Application
of nanomaterials: Photoluminescence, quantum dot lasers, single-electron
transistors, Data storage, Sensors and actuators, MEMS/NEMS, Nanomaterials in
biological applications.Text Books:1.C. C. Koch (ed.): Nanostructured
Materials ÃÂ¢ÃÂÃÂ Processing, Properties and Potential Applications, Noyes
Publications, New York 2001.2.C P Poole and F J Owens: Introduction to
Nanotechnology, Wiley, New York, 2003.
